title: Security Descriptor
description: Policy inputs. Empty local constraint lists never create an authorization grant.

allowed_principals_or_scopes.description: Exact subject references. Empty means no additional descriptor-local allow constraint, not public access.

denied_principals_or_scopes.description: Exact subject references. Any match overrides all allows.

property_restrictions.description: Top-level property names the PEP must omit from the returned projection.

evidence_restrictions.description: Evidence references the PEP must omit; '*' denies all evidence while preserving separately authorized canonical visibility.
